subject: [PATCH 33/60] cgroup/cpuset: ignore private nodes when matching OOM victims

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch addresses a potential issue with private nodes being considered in OOM killer decisions. However, it's unclear whether this change will have any significant impact on system behavior or if it's necessary to fix the described problem.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues related to cgroup/cpuset interactions, specifically focusing on the OOM killer's behavior when dealing with private nodes. The patch in question modifies the cpuset_mems_allowed_intersects function to exclude private memory nodes from the intersection check, ensuring that tasks are not unfairly targeted by the OOM killer due to shared private node allocations.
